decision_conditions: This permission shall be for a limited period expiring on 31 March 2026. The hereby approved floodlighting and associated facilities shall be fully removed no later than the expiry of this permission or within two weeks of the final game, whichever occurs first. The land shall be reinstated to an open landscape and thereafter be retained as such.Reason: To enable the Local Planning Authority to review the suitability of the development in the light of circumstances prevailing at the end of the above period and in the interests of the amenities of the area, Green Belt, heritage, ecological interests and the amenity of surrounding residential occupiers.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Site Location Plan, TCTS-F3A-ZZ-ZZ-ST-A-0870 S2.P1Existing GA Site Plan, TCTS-F3A-ZZ-ZZ-ST-A-0871 S2.P1Proposed GA Site Plan, TCTS-F3A-ZZ-ZZ-ST-A-0873 S2.P1TC Masterplan As Proposed, TCTS-F3A-ZZ-ZZ-ST-A-0872 S2.P1Proposed Speaker Location Plan, TCTS-F3A-ZZ-ZZ-ST-A-0874-S2-P2Lighting Column Detail, 187865X1Proposed Stand Elevation & Sections, H17045_Rev 1Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning

Unless otherwise specified in the application the materials to be used for the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted along with work of making good shall be carried out in materials to match those of the existing building.Reason: To ensure that the appearance of the development respects the appearance, existing materials and built and natural features of the surrounding area.

The temporary floodlighting hereby permitted shall be installed and operated strictly in accordance with the approved plans and supporting documents, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The floodlighting and associated facilities shall not operate after 20:30 hours on any day. Reason: In the interest of the amenity of the Green Belt, heritage, ecological interests and the amenity of surrounding residential occupiers.

The proposed floodlighting hereby approved shall only be erected and finished in accordance with the approved plans and supporting documentation (drawing 187865X1 and light impact assessment), unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interest of the amenity of the Green Belt, ecological interests and the amenity of surrounding residential occupiers.

The proposed development should not exceed the adopted significance criterion of 50 dB as per Noise Impact Assessment (ref: 13495D-20-R01-01) prepared by Logika Group. Reason: To ensure that the amenities of neighbouring premises are protected from noise from the development.
